etymology: a primitive particle [rather from the relative pronoun, 0834] there (transferring to time) then
avSummary: there, therein, thither, whither, in it, thence, thereout
definition:
1) there, thither
    1a) there
    1b) thither (after verbs of motion)
    1c) from there, thence
    1d) then (as an adverb of time)
